name: block
title_zh: 每页只讲一个概念，B5 画布上排成书页
tagline_zh: 写书页像搭积木：一个概念、一张图、一段解释、一个行动框。自带 SVG 或生成照片，严格 B5 画布，排版即终稿。
tagline_en: Book pages like building blocks: one concept, one diagram, one explainer, one action box. Strict B5 canvas.
desc_en: Write and lay out one finished page (a "block") for a book built on the paper engine, on the strict B5 canvas. One concept per page, in the book's own voice, with an inline SVG diagram or a generated photograph, an explainer, and an action box. Use this WHENEVER someone asks for a book page, a block, a new page for the book, a printable explainer, or says "make a block on X", "lay out X as a page"
why_zh: 它把「写内容」和「排版」焊在一起，每页自成闭环。SVG 图或生成照片直接嵌入，不用再开设计工具。
why_en: It welds writing and layout into one pass, each page a self-contained unit. SVG or generated photos embed directly—no design.
limit_zh: 只认 B5 画布和单页概念；不处理跨页章节、多栏杂志或自由版式。SVG 需手写或另备，照片依赖生成模型，超出即停。
limit_en: Only B5 canvas and one-concept pages; no multi-page chapters, multi-column magazines, or free layout. SVG must be hand-coded or pre-made; photos.
title_en: One concept per B5 page, laid out as a book page
